CANDIDATE for bd-01M174W3J09YF6Q733GDSQFHDZ (SinkhornConfig NaN epsilon).

  SHA: 178b20c458b2dc956c34989e05e28053a916f1af
  branch: sinkhorn-nan-config
  worktree: .worktrees/cursor-grok-coverage
  parent: e4bbf5b (current main). merge-base --is-ancestor e4bbf5b 178b20c is true.
  reservation: rv-01M17FVQSTWS5V6G17KGRHTWER
  paths: align/.../sinkhorn.scala, align/.../SinkhornSuite.scala only.

WHAT CHANGED
The validator polarity, nothing else. Was:

  else if config.epsilon <= 0.0 || config.rhoRows < 0.0 || config.rhoCols < 0.0 then Left
  else compute

Now:

  else if config.epsilon > 0.0 && config.rhoRows >= 0.0 && config.rhoCols >= 0.0 then compute
  else Left(InvalidConfig)

NaN fails every comparison, so it now takes Left. rho == 0 stays legal (unconstrained marginal).

MUTATION
Restored the old `<= 0.0 || < 0.0` polarity on a warm worktree. Mutant compiled.
SinkhornSuite: 1 failed / 8 passed / 9 total.
Discriminating failure is the named assertion (SinkhornSuite.scala:84):

  NaN epsilon must not enter the iteration: Right(SinkhornResult(
    Vector(Vector(0.0, 0.0), Vector(0.0, 0.0)), ..., 200, false))

That is the exact bead defect. Sibling `epsilon = 0.0` test stayed green.
Restored the fail-closed guard; suite 9/9 green after the restore.

GATE (unpiped; GATE_EXIT appended to each log)
1. compileAll — success (log /tmp/sinkhorn-nan-gate.txt; that run then died on a
   mistaken `align/test` key, not on compile).
2. alignJVM/test + alignJS/test + alignNative/test + scalafmtCheckAll last
   — GATE_EXIT=0 in /tmp/sinkhorn-nan-gate2.txt
   199 / 199 / 199 passed (0 failed). SinkhornSuite 9/9 on each platform.
   scalafmtCheckAll [success].

REFERENCE SCOPE
tools/reference-scope.sh e4bbf5b HEAD printed "no types defined in changed files"
(method-body only; no new type). Hand grep of SinkhornConfig / UnbalancedSinkhorn
across */src/{main,test}/scala hits only align. Gated align on all three
platforms plus compileAll.

SCOUT WIDENING (post-01M17FWP6CVKASG17D38Q3G08G)
I saw it. Their disposable-clone probe is load-bearing: +Inf epsilon still
passes `> 0.0` and claims a converged all-ones plan; NaN/+Inf tolerance and
maxIterations=0 are also unguarded. That is a larger validator contract than
the polarity flip this bead named. I stayed inside the claimed polarity so the
NaN-epsilon hole can land now. Same two reserved paths. If the chief acks the
whole-config boundary I will widen on this reservation and re-gate; I will not
widen without that ack.

C stays with cursor-grok-storymodel4s. I am not reclaiming it.
